takes.title: Adjust Hair and Walk Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, brings a hand to the head several times, lowers the arm, and walks forward with a relaxed arm swing.

takes.title: Walk Forward with Alternating Arm Swings
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps forward with a relaxed alternating arm swing and continues through the last frame.

takes.title: Walk and Ease into a Side-Facing Stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with low arms, shortens the final steps, and settles upright facing to one side.

takes.title: Walk Briskly after a Brief Hand Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a hand near the face before taking a series of brisk steps, then slows into a side-facing stance.

takes.title: Lean Low into a Heavy Push and Release
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward with both hands low and takes braced steps, then eases out of the lean and straightens.

takes.title: Push a Heavy Box from a Low Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer sinks into bent knees, leans over both hands, and advances with short braced steps. The final pose remains pitched forward.

takes.title: Crouch and Pull a Heavy Object
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops into a deep crouch, gathers both hands near the floor, and backs away with bent knees and the arms in front.

takes.title: Drag a Heavy Object with Repeated Low Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches down in a crouch, then takes short backward steps while remaining bent over with both hands low.

takes.title: Bend to Grip and Drag a Heavy Object
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds at the waist, straightens partway, and repeatedly steps back with the arms drawn in. They turn into profile near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: push object that is high in air
takes.title: Push High with Both Arms and Lower Them
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands near head level, maintains a high forward reach while shifting stance, and lowers the arms to finish.

takes.sourceDescription: push object that is high in air
takes.title: Reach Up and Push with Changing Foot Position
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into an elevated two-handed push, alternates the reach with one arm stretched farther, and returns to standing with arms down.

takes.title: Jump Backward off a Ledge and Land Low
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms, leaves the ledge backward, and catches the landing in a deep bend before walking out.

takes.title: Jump Backward off a Ledge with Arms Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts the arms, jumps backward, and opens them while bending the knees on landing. They continue into short steps afterward.

takes.title: Climb Backward Down a Ledge
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the hands, turns and lowers into a hands-down position, then brings the feet under the body and stands.

takes.title: Lower Backward off a Ledge and Stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes several preparatory arm motions, turns away, lowers to a near-horizontal supported position, then steps down and straightens.

takes.title: Hold a Brief Bent-Knee Pose with Hands Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a staggered stance with both hands raised in front and knees slightly bent. The captured motion is nearly static.

takes.title: Walk Forward with Short Even Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes short forward steps with arms low and continues through the final frame.

takes.title: Bring a Hand to the Head and Walk Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a hand to the head twice, lowers it, and walks away in profile with a relaxed arm swing.
